stage_definitions.S0: interest area only -> EXPLORATION (present options; human chooses)
stage_definitions.S1: problem stated, no RQ -> EXPLORATION (gap map and RQ drafts; human approves)
stage_definitions.S3: RQ, method, and data defined -> METHODOLOGY (short closest-work check, then Gate 2)
stage_definitions.S4: continuation or revision with existing material -> REVISION (resume at the relevant gate)
